description: Create a List - Create a new contact list. Contacts added to lists must originate from an evidenced import or consent source that the account holder already has (e.g. their own opt-in list, CRM export, or inbound leads) — not addresses assembled by the model. The response includes a `fields` array — the list's columns in snake_case (e.g. first_name, email).

archive_invalid.description: Archive contacts with invalid emails after verification

archive_risky.description: Archive contacts with risky emails after verification

folder.description: Optional general folder ID to organize the list. Must be a folder created without a type (i.e., not an email-sender folder).

verification.description: Enable email verification for contacts in this list

workspace_id.description: Workspace ID this action applies to. When omitted, the current or default workspace is used.

name: create_list

result.description: The raw result returned by the SalesBlink tool.

title: Create List
